title: pix_opencv_matchshape
description: `pix_opencv_matchshape` compares a contour against loaded template contours using OpenCV’s `cv::matchShapes` function to recognize corresponding shapes. Add templates with a `template` point-list message, compare contours with a `contour` point-list message, and configure recognition using `method` (1, 2, or 3) and `threshold` messages.
